answers.answer: The reviewed draft's neutral ISchemaAssessmentInput.OwnsNode(IXdmNode) is the right source-membership boundary for ordinary persistent XML. Current PersistentXdmNode is sealed and retains private _snapshot/_id; its constructor validates snapshot.GetNode(nodeId), and all Open-created descendants retain the same actual snapshot. IsSameNode checks the concrete provider type and snapshot reference plus node ID; it never calls arbitrary foreign node getters, but it compares only one node, not arbitrary descendant membership. There is currently NO implemented general OwnsNode/OwnsSnapshot adapter or accessible snapshot-membership method. Feasible plan: add a provider-local trusted membership bridge inside the Xdm implementation that first type-checks this sealed provider, checks the actual retained snapshot reference (including live-owner check), then uses the already validated stored ID if necessary. Do not traverse/copy the graph, compare DocumentId/CommitSequence/URI labels as authority, call a purported foreign node's Document/Parent/NodeKind getters, or fake an existing membership API. This requires a local XmlDb adapter change and tests, not an additional required Core IXdmNode member.

For XmlDb this is ordinary source membership ONLY: reference equality of the actual ImmutableXmlSnapshot owner plus a valid local node ID. Same IDs or bytes in another snapshot/generation/import/copy do not confer membership. PersistentXdmNode.TypedValue currently returns XdmValue.FromString(StringValue); optional schema defaults remain ordinary legacy behavior. This provider issues no schema facts/origin/components and cannot authenticate preserved or copied PSVI. Schema's OwnsNode(node,facts,input,origin) remains a separate issuer obligation, not satisfied by XmlDb membership. Do not alter untyped atomization/numeric semantics or FXG-01 by this design review.

Ordinary XmlDb admission must use assessor=null, session Advisor=null, originalAssessment=null and no fabricated compatibility view or schema origin. The revised snapshot argument on ReadTypedValue and input/originalAssessment on advisor OwnsTypedValue can express source-specific schema-issued values when a real Schema adapter exists. Those issuer checks are explicitly not applicable to this ordinary XmlDb profile because this provider supplies no ISchemaTypedValue/schema assessment. Never route current string TypedValue through a fabricated schema container. No current implementation of the new proposal route is claimed.

Concrete candidate feasibility plan, not new runtime evidence: own an actual BeginRead snapshot; verify root/child/attribute/namespace wrappers of that snapshot are members without reading their content. Reject a throwing foreign IXdmNode before any getter, a wrapper from a second BeginRead with identical DocumentId/CommitSequence, an independently imported/copied document and an invalid node ID. Revoke input/close admission while raw work owns a lease; reject subsequent entries and keep the actual snapshot until raw completion. After actual snapshot disposal, availability checks reject. Include duplicate admissions, two generations and disposed-input controls, plus original node identity/order/namespace/error regression. The private membership bridge and exact R2 candidate adapter remain unimplemented; these are R4 obligations. No additional required Core signature is demonstrated by source mapping; accepted design scope is only the neutral ordinary-source shape, not implemented ownership or human sign-off.
